Bengaluru Hotels Inspected for Food Safety Violations

Health and food safety officials in Bengaluru have launched inspections targeting three-star and five-star hotels, as well as other food establishments. Special teams were formed to conduct these drives. During the inspections, authorities reportedly found expired food items, including meat and milk, and vegetables with fungus. Over 300 kilograms of unsafe food were allegedly seized. Several hotels are now under scrutiny for these alleged food safety and hygiene violations.
